name: mutY DNA glycosylase

function.text: MUTYH encodes adenine DNA glycosylase. Annotated molecular activities include DNA N-glycosylase activity and 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanine DNA N-glycosylase activity. It participates in DNA repair and mismatch repair.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include familial adenomatous polyposis 2 (autosomal recessive). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Amphicrine-like carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: MUTYH encodes adenine DNA glycosylase. It participates in oxidative DNA damage repair. It initiates repair of A*oxoG to C*G by removing the inappropriately paired adenine base from the DNA backbone. It possesses both adenine and 2-OH-A DNA glycosylase activities.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include familial adenomatous polyposis 2 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MUTYH have been reported in amphicrine-like carcinoma.
